account: In July 2022 a healthy woman in her early 40s was admitted to Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center, Israel. She had a month of worsening headaches. Imaging showed a 2.6 cm left apical lung adenocarcinoma with leptomeningeal spread; biopsy tissue was scarce. To guide gene testing without exhausting tissue, the team ran Imagene's deep-learning algorithm on the H&E slide. Within 48 hours of biopsy it inferred EGFR mutation positivity. A rapid Idylla PCR assay confirmed the L858R exon 21 mutation; osimertinib started two days after biopsy. The authors say that was one week earlier than routine practice and avoided whole-neuraxis radiotherapy. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) at two months showed the enhancement gone.

ai_role.statement: The AI inference directed which rapid test to run; treatment began only after PCR confirmation. The AI therefore changed the sequence and speed of testing rather than the final diagnosis. Authors are Tel Aviv Sourasky / Tel Aviv University clinicians declaring no competing interests. A second patient in the report (February 2023) followed the same path.

fields.account: In July 2022 a healthy woman in her early 40s was admitted to Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center, Israel. She had a month of worsening headaches. Imaging showed a 2.6 cm left apical lung adenocarcinoma with leptomeningeal spread; biopsy tissue was scarce. To guide gene testing without exhausting tissue, the team ran Imagene's deep-learning algorithm on the H&E slide. Within 48 hours of biopsy it inferred EGFR mutation positivity. A rapid Idylla PCR assay confirmed the L858R exon 21 mutation; osimertinib started two days after biopsy. The authors say that was one week earlier than routine practice and avoided whole-neuraxis radiotherapy. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) at two months showed the enhancement gone.
